nodes.name: Installer.template.yaml
nodes.summary: WinGet installer manifest template for NousResearch.HermesDesktop. Defines the NSIS installer metadata with placeholders (VERSION, RELEASE_DATE, INSTALLER_URL, INSTALLER_SHA256) that are replaced at build time by scripts/generate-winget-manifests.mjs. Targets x64 Windows 10 1809+ with user-scope install.

nodes.name: Locale.en-US.template.yaml
nodes.summary: WinGet locale manifest template (en-US) for NousResearch.HermesDesktop. Contains package metadata: publisher (Nous Research), package name (Hermes One), MIT license, short/long descriptions, tags (ai, agent, desktop, electron, llm), and a RELEASE_NOTES_URL placeholder.

nodes.name: Version.template.yaml
nodes.summary: WinGet version manifest template for NousResearch.HermesDesktop. Minimal file with PackageIdentifier, VERSION placeholder, and default locale (en-US).
